configQuickReplyKeyTooltip: Press this key within 5 seconds of an NPC speaking to send a quick follow-up reply.
configEnableBarkTooltip: NPCs will occasionally think out loud or comment on their surroundings and daily life in overhead speech bubbles as you pass by. (Uses a small amount of tokens)
configEnableSuggestedResponsesTooltip: When enabled, AI generates 2-3 dialogue reply choices. Disable to save tokens and prevent small model hallucinations. The dialogue box will only keep 'Stay silent' and custom typing options.
configRecordEventDialogueTooltip: Record NPC dialogue and farmer choices during events and cutscenes into the history.
configEnableA2ATooltip: When villagers cross paths, they'll pause for a short, natural conversation — the AI generates each villager's lines in one pass, based on their relationships, individual speech patterns, surroundings, and the latest town news. (Uses a small amount of tokens)
configEnableProactiveMicroSocialTooltip: When disabled, all Barks fall back to Soliloquy (proactive micro-social interactions are disabled).
configMicroSocialMidFriendshipChanceTool: Probability of triggering a micro-social interaction at 3-6 hearts; 7+ hearts always triggers, 0-2 hearts never triggers.

configRespectAuthorConsentTooltip: Enabled by default. When on, follows third-party mod authors' declarations on whether their NPCs may be used with AI dialogue. Turning this off removes that restriction, enabling AI dialogue for all custom NPCs.
logPermitAiUseBypassed: [AI Consent] The user has disabled this restriction. AI dialogue is now enabled for all NPCs.

configEnableSpouseScheduleTooltip: Lets married spouses follow a dynamic daily schedule, wander the farm, and visit locations around town.
configEnableDateSystemTooltip: Lets you and your dating partner or spouse invite each other out — you can propose a date, or they may invite you, with the location chosen freely from the available list. Currently experimental and disabled by default.
configAutoSummarizeDailyTooltip: Each morning, if yesterday's interactions >= 3, automatically write a diary entry.
configAutoSummarizeWeeklyTooltip: Every Monday, if the past 7 days have >= 3 diary entries, automatically condense into a weekly report.
configAutoSummarizeSeasonTooltip: On the 1st of each season, if last season has >= 2 weekly reports, automatically condense into a season report.
configAutoSummarizeYearlyTooltip: On Spring 1 each year, if last year has >= 2 season reports, automatically condense into a yearly report.
configStatusFailed: *Connection Failed* — check your API key, network connection, or the console log
configStatusNotConfigured: *Not Configured* — check the provider, model name, or network connection
configApiKeyTooltip: API key for the AI model provider. Required for cloud models; leave empty for local models (Ollama / LM Studio).
configAdvancedWarning:
Warning: if you're not sure what these settings do, leave them at their default values! Invalid values can cause API errors,

rejected requests, or garbled/erratic NPC dialogue.

Note: Custom Body JSON currently only works with OpenAI-compatible endpoints and isn't supported for Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude.

If you need support for those providers, please open an issue on GitHub.
configTemperatureTooltip: Controls randomness and creativity. Range: 0.0–2.0, default 0.9. Higher values are more random, lower values more conservative. Recommended to leave at default for most cases.
configTopPTooltip: Nucleus sampling threshold for output diversity. Range: 0.0–1.0, default 0.9. Works together with Temperature. Recommended to leave at default.
configMaxTokensTooltip: Maximum number of tokens (roughly characters) per response. Range: 100–8192, default 1024. NPC dialogue rarely exceeds 200 characters, so 1024 is already generous. Higher values increase API cost and wait time.
configCustomBodyJsonTooltip:
For advanced users: enter a valid JSON object (e.g. {"presence_penalty": 0.5}) to deep-merge into the request payload.

Can be used to inject provider-specific parameters or override thinking mode. Leave blank to use the default payload.

Note: only applies to the 'Custom (OpenAI-Compatible)' provider, and only affects the main player-to-NPC dialogue 

— it does not affect ambient NPC chatter (Bark) or NPC-to-NPC conversations (A2A).
configServerAddressTooltip:
For local models (Ollama / LM Studio) or preset cloud providers, leave this empty — the mod will use the default endpoint automatically.
Only enter a base URL here if you have changed the local port or are using a self-hosted relay/reverse proxy.
configProxyModeTooltip: Choose how the mod connects to LLM APIs. System uses OS settings, Direct bypasses any proxy, Custom lets you specify a proxy URL.
configCustomProxyUrlTooltip: Used when Proxy Mode is set to Custom. Enter a full URL including scheme, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.
